description: A multipass glass rendering library for Defold with screen-space double refraction, thickness-based distortion, optional color absorption and local cubemap reflection probes. Supports lighting from Defold light components and configurable reflection modes that update probes every frame, capture once or use pre-rendered cubemaps. Includes a reusable Lua render module, glass materials and example scenes with glass spheres, a wine glass and planar mirror reflections. Integrates with custom render pipelines and requires Defold 1.14.0 or newer.
name: Defold Glass

releases.message:
Requires Defold 1.14.0 or newer.

- Replaced six separate reflection render targets with a native cubemap render target.
- Added support for Defold light components, replacing the custom specular light.
- Switched opaque models to use built-in lit materials.
- Improved glass refraction and added softer, rough reflections.
- Added optional planar reflections for flat surfaces, including reflections of glass objects. This requires additional rendering passes.
- Updated the example scenes with a Defold logo, glass spheres, reflective floors, and a slowly rotating skybox in the wine scene.
- Fixed material warnings and render-target cleanup.
First release of the ported Fake Real Glass for Defold
